1. Wall Tasks (Corkboard Board)

-

- Wall Tasks aapka visual kanban aur detective-style corkboard hai. Isme aap do views ke beech switch kar sakte hain: + {/* SECTION 1 */} +

+ +

1. Wall Tasks (Visual Corkboard)

+
+ +

+ Ye module tasks ko ek realistic investigation board ki tarah manage karta hai.

-
    -
  • Pin Board View: Freehand drag-and-drop workspace jahan cards natural pushpin physics ke sath board bounds ke andar rehte hain.
    • -
  • Grid View: Ek structured, auto-aligned card grid jisme har card content ke hisab se dynamic height leta hai.
    • -
  • Multi-color Cards: Sticky yellow, obsidian black, emerald green, aur rose pink tones.
    • -
+ +
+

Kaise Use Karein (Step-by-Step Guide):

+
    +
  1. Card Add Karna: Upar diye gaye + Add Card button par click karein. Checklists ya Plain Note me se ek select karein, title aur paper color choose karein.
    2. +
  2. Position Move Karna: Pin Board mode me card ko ungli ya mouse se drag karke board par kisi bhi jagah arrange karein. Cards board frame ke bahar nahi jaate.
    3. +
  3. Grid View Switch: Agar screen clean aur auto-aligned chahiye, toh top bar se Grid View toggle karein.
    4. +
  4. Task Complete Karna: Card ke andar checkbox par tap karein ya niche diye Mark/Done button ko click karein.
    5. +
  5. Multi-Select Delete: Top right ke Select drop-down se multiple cards choose karke ek sath Delete karein.
    6. +
+
-
-

2. 3D Notebook (Protected Diary)

-

- Ek realistic 2-page spread digital notebook jisme journal entries aur long-form thoughts likh sakte hain: + {/* SECTION 2 */} +

+
+ +

2. 3D Notebook (Protected Diary)

+
+ +

+ Ye ek dual-page open book hai jo journal entries, code snippets aur thoughts likhne ke liye designed hai.

-
    -
  • PIN Protection: 4-digit PIN setup karke apni personal diary lock kar sakte hain.
    • -
  • Vintage Leather Covers: Obsidian Black, Vintage Leather, Emerald Velvet aur Royal Blue themes.
    • -
  • Natural Page Ruled Lines: Custom 28px ruled lines aur minimal smooth scrollbar.
    • -
+ +
+

Kaise Use Karein (Step-by-Step Guide):

+
    +
  1. Writing on Left Page: Title aur textarea me likhna shuru karein. Har word real-time auto-save hota hai.
    2. +
  2. PIN Setup (Security): Top bar me Set PIN par click karein aur 4-digit code save karein. Uske baad Lock Book dabate hi book bina PIN ke open nahi hogi.
    3. +
  3. Cover Badalna: Cover button par tap karke Obsidian Black, Vintage Leather, Emerald Velvet ya Royal Blue skin lagayein.
    4. +
  4. Page Flip Karna: Left aur Right outer border arrows se pages turn karein. Mobile me bottom Prev/Next buttons ka use karein.
    5. +
  5. Naya Page Banana: Jab akhiri page par pahunchein, tab + Add New Page dabayein.
    6. +
+
-
-

3. Quick Notes & Sketch Pad

-

- Legal yellow pad design jisme text aur hand-drawn sketches dono save hote hain: + {/* SECTION 3 */} +

+
+ +

3. Quick Notes & Doodle Canvas

+
+ +

+ Desk memo pad jahan text notes ke sath hand-drawn sketches aur diagrams draw kiye ja sakte hain.

-
    -
  • Smart Magic Eraser: Photoshop jaisa contiguous color recognition tool jo tap karne par poore stroke ya shape ko ek click me erase kar deta hai.
    • -
  • Geometric Objects: Rectangle, Circle, Line aur Star direct canvas par drop karein.
    • -
  • Copy As Image: Card ke copy button se sketch direct PNG image clipboard me copy hoti hai.
    • -
+ +
+

Kaise Use Karein (Step-by-Step Guide):

+
    +
  1. Text Note: + New Note dabayein, category tag (Work, Ideas, etc.) chunein aur save karein.
    2. +
  2. Draw / Sketch Mode: Modal ke top switcher se Draw & Objects select karein.
    3. +
  3. Smart Magic Eraser: Magic wand icon par tap karein aur canvas par jis stroke/shape par tap karenge, wo shape Photoshop ki tarah ek touch me disappear ho jayega.
    4. +
  4. Geometric Shapes: Rectangle, Circle, Line aur Star tool choose karke canvas par drag karein.
    5. +
  5. Direct Image Copy: Card ke copy button par tap karte hi drawing direct real PNG image ke roop me clipboard me copy ho jati hai (WhatsApp/Photoshop me sidhe paste ho sakti hai).
    6. +
+
+ + {/* SECTION 4 */} +
+
+ +

4. Google Drive Cloud Sync

+
+ +

+ Guest users ka sara data device ke localStorage me rehta hai. Apne data ko har device par lane ke liye top header me Link Drive par tap karein. +

+

+ Sync ho jane ke baad aapka data aapke khud ke Google Drive ke secure appDataFolder me save hota hai. +

+
